scientific_integrity: The cost minimizer and its 120-degree threshold are classical; novelty is claimed only for the sharp small-excess critical-window area coefficient, its crossover, and the marked conditional limit. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: The sharp asymptotic is for fixed positive adjacent side lengths and each fixed finite critical-window parameter; no simultaneous divergent-parameter uniformity is asserted.
The three foci have equal positive weights and are exactly the vertices of the sampling triangle; the sampling is Euclidean area-uniform.
The nonstandard uniform localization and total-variation claims are established analytically; numerical quadrature is diagnostic only.
The complete text of Groß and Strempel (1998) could not be inspected; independent priority validation is not performed.
title: A sharp \(120^\circ\) crossover for near-optimal three-focus regions
